endless_gravity.config.title: Endless Gravity Settings
endless_gravity.config.group.fall_damage: Choose whether players and mobs take fall damage in The End and Sable sub-levels.
endless_gravity.config.group.gameplay.he: Global gravity-effect settings and entities excluded from reduced gravity.
endless_gravity.config.group.client.help: These settings only affect what you see and hear on your client.
endless_gravity.config.group.sable.help: Advanced settings for Sable sub-levels. Changes require regenerating its datapack.
endless_gravity.config.generalHelp: Shared and visual settings. Configure each dimension's gravity in the Dimensions tab.
endless_gravity.config.dimensionProfiles: Entity gravity settings are managed under Dimensions.
Add one profile for each dimension you want to configure. Changes apply when you press Save.
Remember to press Save to apply your pending changes.
endless_gravity.config.dimensionStepId: 1. Enter the ID of the dimension you want to configure.
endless_gravity.config.dimensionStepMode: 2. Choose how gravity should work there.
endless_gravity.config.dimensionStepSett: 3. Adjust the selected mode and add the profile.
endless_gravity.config.dimensionNoProfil: No profiles yet. Add one above to configure a dimension.
endless_gravity.config.dimensionChangeMo: Choose a mode. Only its settings are shown; switching modes keeps the previous settings.
endless_gravity.config.preset.vanilla.to: Reset every fixed-gravity offset to zero.
endless_gravity.config.preset.light_grav: Apply a gentle gravity reduction to every supported entity type.
endless_gravity.config.preset.lunar.tool: Apply a stronger fixed-gravity profile inspired by lunar gravity.
endless_gravity.config.preset.terrestria: Use the default atmosphere curve and gravity profile.
endless_gravity.config.preset.gentle_atm: Use a gentler gravity ramp and softer audio filtering.
endless_gravity.config.preset.thin_atmos: Use a thin atmosphere that reaches vacuum at lower altitude.
Quick presets and your saved atmosphere profiles. Applying one fills in editable values.
endless_gravity.config.customPresetsHelp: Manage, import, or export your saved atmosphere profiles as JSON.
endless_gravity.config.myAtmospherePrese: Apply a saved atmosphere profile to this dimension.
endless_gravity.config.deletePresetButto: Remove this preset from your local library; save the screen to keep the change.
endless_gravity.config.savePresetName.to: Enter a unique name. Saving the same name replaces that preset.
endless_gravity.config.saveCurrentAsPres: Save this dimension's current atmosphere values as a reusable preset.
endless_gravity.config.importPresets.too: Validate and merge the presets from the JSON field into your library.
endless_gravity.config.exportPresets.too: Copy all saved atmosphere presets as JSON to the clipboard.
endless_gravity.config.dimensionCreateBu: Add this configured dimension profile to the editor. It is not saved until you press Save.
endless_gravity.config.dimensionRemoveBu: Remove this profile from the editor. Save to apply, or use Undo before saving.
endless_gravity.config.dimensionUndo.too: Restore this removed profile before saving.
endless_gravity.config.dimensionMode.atm: Use altitude-based gravity and atmosphere settings for players and mobs.
endless_gravity.config.dimensionMode.fix: Set independent gravity offsets for each supported entity type.
endless_gravity.config.dimensionFixedGra: Offsets are per tick: positive values reduce gravity, negative values increase it, and zero keeps vanilla gravity.
endless_gravity.config.dimensionAtmosphe: Gravity changes smoothly with altitude; the pressure curve also controls atmosphere audio and Sable data.
endless_gravity.config.atmosphereBaseAlt: Altitude where the smooth gravity reduction begins.
endless_gravity.config.atmosphereMuffleG: Overall audio level in low-pressure areas. Set to zero to disable muffling.
High-frequency audio level in low-pressure areas. Lower values remove more treble.
endless_gravity.config.playerGravityOffs: Additional upward force applied to players each tick.
Additional upward force applied to mobs each tick.
endless_gravity.config.itemGravityOffset: Additional upward force applied to dropped items each tick.
endless_gravity.config.arrowGravityOffse: Additional upward force applied to arrows each tick.
endless_gravity.config.thrownGravityOffs: Additional upward force applied to thrown projectiles each tick.
endless_gravity.config.blockGravityOffse: Additional upward force applied to falling blocks each tick.
endless_gravity.config.curveLayer.toolti: Each point defines pressure at its altitude; points must stay in ascending altitude order.
endless_gravity.config.columnAltitude.to: World Y coordinate of this atmosphere point. It must remain between neighboring layers.
endless_gravity.config.columnPressure.to: Pressure at this altitude: 1 is normal atmosphere, 0 is vacuum.
endless_gravity.config.curveAddLayer.too: Add a point in the widest available altitude gap.
Remove this point. At least two atmosphere layers must remain.
endless_gravity.config.curveGraphHelp: Drag points: left/right changes altitude and up/down changes pressure.
endless_gravity.config.importPresetsJson: Paste exported preset JSON here before importing.

Positive values reduce gravity; negative values increase it. 0 keeps vanilla gravity.
endless_gravity.config.dimensionAtmosphe: Gravity gradually decreases from the start altitude to the maximum at the last layer. Layers control pressure and audio.
endless_gravity.config.sableAtmosphereCu: General fallback curve for Sable when the Overworld is not in Atmosphere mode.
endless_gravity.config.restartWarning: Sable changes apply to newly loaded worlds. Restart or reload the world to apply.
endless_gravity.config.atmosphereGravity: Maximum upward force at the last atmosphere layer in this dimension.
endless_gravity.config.noFallDamageAltit: No fall damage if a fall starts above (Y)
Compared with the estimated altitude where the fall began. Set to -1 to disable.
The altitude-to-pressure curve controls pressure and muffled audio; in Sable it also drives its datapack. Pressure 1.0 = full atmosphere, 0.0 = vacuum.
endless_gravity.config.gravityImmuneEnti: Entity IDs (e.g. minecraft:zombie) excluded from reduced gravity, in addition to the gravity_immune tag.
